blocks.text: Observation logon ya cheezon ko un ke qudrati mahol mein, dakhal diye baghair, dekh kar data jama karta hai. Restaurant jaanna chahta hai ke gahak lunch par kaunsi mezein chunte hain; ek mulazim ek hafte tak baithne ka intikhab likhta hai, aur restaurant aaram, gahakon ki aamad o raft aur khidmat behtar karne ke liye nashist badalta hai.

blocks.prompt: Gahakon se poochne ki bajaye observation behtar data kyun de sakta hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh darj karta hai ke log asal mein kya karte hain, na ke kya kehte hain, aur un ke rawayye mein khalal nahi dalta.

items: Observation: dakhal ke baghair dekhna; maslan ek hafte ki lunch nashist.
